newsitem.title: UK: Fairey raises bid for Burnfield.
newsitem.headline: Fairey raises bid for Burnfield.

text.p: UK electronics and specialist engineering manufacturer Fairey Plc on Tuesday announced a higher and final offer for Burnfield Plc.
Fairey said its offer of 25 new Fairey shares for every 92 Burnfield shares valued each Burnfield share at 165p and the company's issued share capital at 57.7 million pounds.
Previously Fairey offered one new share for every four Burnfield shares, valuing the group at 51.1 million pounds.
Fairey said its offer continued to depend on Burnfield refraining from a proposed 24-million-pound acquisition or the associated seven for 10 rights issue.
Burnfield shares closed one pence lower at 142-1/2p in London. The announcement came after the stock exchange closed.
